_about: Real English EX-era theme decks of ex1-ex8 (written 2026-11-26): 16 decks (Ruby, Sapphire, Oasis, Caravan, WindBlast, FireFang, Team Magma, Team Aqua, Wish Maker, Forest Guardian, FireRed, LeafGreen, Jessie, James, Starcharge, Jetstream). Lists from Bulbapedia deck pages (MediaWiki API) cross-checked row by row against Serebii theme deck pages (serebii.net/card/themedeck/<name>.shtml); 11 decks agree exactly, 5 differ in 1-2 cards (Caravan, FireFang, FireRed, Starcharge, Jetstream, see each deck's notes); Bulbapedia used because every Bulbapedia list sums to 60. pokewiki.de and pkmncards were unreachable/blocked; pikawiz Cloudflare-blocked. Card ids resolved against data/exN.json: all 960 entries resolve to the exact set/number and name. Deck-exclusive prints (non-holo Groudon/Kyogre/Metagross/Azumarill/Dark Marowak/Camerupt/Shedinja, cosmos-holo Dark Tyranitar/Dark Dragonite/Deoxys/Rayquaza) have no separate TCGplayer product, so showcaseTcgplayerId is null; showcaseCard is the set's normal print. TCGplayer sealed products exist for only 10 of 16 decks (none for Oasis, WindBlast, Team Aqua, FireRed, Jessie, James); marketPrice is null for all (tcgcsv gives no market price; only FireFang has one low-price listing, 499.99). Box contents: 60 cards, damage counters, coin, rulebook, card list, single-player mat (not Sandstorm/Dragon); no booster pack in any source. Not covered: ex9 and later (Emerald etc.). Energy: both sources give the exact ex1 numbers (104-109, Darkness 93, Metal 94, Rainbow 95), so no energy print was assumed. Showcase card for Oasis, Caravan, WindBlast, FireRed and LeafGreen is inferred (no source names a featured card; the deck's rare holo was used).
